# bWalletX

> bWalletX is the full edition of the wallet (web app, Chrome extension, Android sideload APK and a private iPhone build, with the iPhone web app from Safari for everyone else); bWallet is the App Store / Google Play edition with fewer features. Both are non-custodial Bitcoin SV (BSV) wallets from The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd, forked from the open-source Yours Wallet (MIT). bwallet.space is the older bWallet store-edition site (it still hosts the testing waitlist); bwalletx.com is the main site. Beta software: test with small amounts.

bWalletX includes an Exchange for tokens and NFTs, token-gated chat rooms, a bApps store, an on-chain media player, b (a built-in AI assistant), agent accounts with strategies, and PNEEs (Penny Stablecoins, a BSV-backed dollar token in a capped mainnet pilot).

Full text of every page below: https://bwalletx.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- [bWalletX: the smart social super wallet](https://bwalletx.com/): bWalletX is the smart social super wallet: your token, your payments and your rooms in one place. Lock BSV, pots and subscriptions, history and export, token rooms, games, handles and the Exchange. Non-custodial Bitcoin SV wallet for Android, Chrome and the web.
- [Get bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/get): Get bWalletX for Android, Chrome, the web and iPhone.
- [bWalletX for Android](https://bwalletx.com/android): Download the bWalletX Android app (APK): the BSV wallet for tokens, media and apps.
- [bWalletX on iPhone](https://bwalletx.com/iphone): Use bWalletX on iPhone today: install the web app from Safari in under a minute. No App Store needed.
- [bWalletX for Chrome](https://bwalletx.com/extension): Install the bWalletX Chrome extension: the full bWalletX wallet in Chrome's side panel, and a wallet websites can connect to.
- [bWalletX Features](https://bwalletx.com/features): Everything bWalletX does: BSV and tokens, names and paymail, token rooms, calls, market, media, minting, and a wallet websites can connect to.
- [Watch: bWalletX in one minute](https://bwalletx.com/video): A one-minute tour of bWalletX: create a wallet, back it up, dollar balances, the Exchange, the Apps store, the Feed and group chats, and b, your AI agent.
- [Get 1 BSV: test bWallet on Android](https://bwalletx.com/testers): Get 1 BSV for testing bWallet on Android for 14 days. 20 places. Apply with Google; paid to your own bWallet.
- [Buy BSV in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/buy): Buy BSV right in bWalletX: tap the gold Buy BSV card, pay with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank through an independent provider, or receive from an exchange or a friend. Your BSV lands in your wallet, shown in dollars.
- [Restore into bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/restore): Every wallet you can restore or sweep into bWalletX: Yours, Panda, RelayX, Twetch, SimplyCash, BIP44 wallets, private keys and xprvs, and Money Button. What each needs and what comes across.
- [History in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/history): See every transaction your bWalletX account made, for any date range, and export it as CSV or a PDF statement for your accountant.
- [Push notifications · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/push-notifications): Push notifications are live in bWalletX: direct messages, mentions, group messages you opt into, $b answers and signing requests on iPhone, Android, the web wallet and the Chrome extension, even with the app closed. Who messaged you, not what they wrote.
- [bWalletX web wallet](https://bwalletx.com/web): Use bWalletX in your browser: no install, your keys stay in your browser, works on any computer. The same wallet as the app. Beta.
- [bTV: AIVJ: watch VexVoid play live](https://bwalletx.com/aivj): bTV: AIVJ is VexVoid’s live channel. Watch the first three minutes without signing in, then pay 1p a minute from bWalletX, straight to the artist. Close the page to stop.
- [Artists on bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/artists): Listen to independent artists on bWalletX, paid by the second. Start with VexVoid's Echoes in the Abyss: tracks 1–6 are on VexVoid, 7–12 at 1 sat/sec.
- [VexVoid on bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/artists/vexvoid): V3XV0ID: trainyards, rooftops, the void. Listen to Echoes in the Abyss and watch Four Ton Shadow in bWalletX, paid by the second.
- [Ask b](https://bwalletx.com/ask-b): Ask b, the assistant inside bWalletX. Type a question and b helps: send money, make a pot, explain something, fix a problem.
- [b cool](https://bwalletx.com/b-cool): Less noise. More life. Just b.
- [bApps: apps that run inside bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/bapps): bApps are Bitcoin apps that open inside bWalletX: sign in with your wallet, pay from your wallet, one bar across every app. bChat, bMovies, bMusic, bMint, bWriter and more.
- [bMovies inside bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/bapps/bmovies): bMovies is a film feed on Bitcoin SV: watch thousands of films, sign in with bWalletX, back the films you like with their tokens. What works today and what is coming.
- [bPhone](https://bwalletx.com/bphone): bPhone: charge to receive calls in bWalletX. Set a price per second, minute, hour or call in BSV, MNEE or a token; list yourself with your hours; take bookings. The caller pays your wallet as you talk.
- [bPositive](https://bwalletx.com/bpositive): Sponsor someone’s journey in bWalletX: monthly support from pots, milestone pledges confirmed by witnesses, thank-you NFTs. Gifts only, 18+, 0% fee. Coming.
- [bRadio: live audio Spaces in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/bradio): bRadio in bWalletX: live audio Spaces. Host a Space, bring listeners up on stage, record it as a podcast episode, and get paid straight to you.
- [bShares: share registers for companies](https://bwalletx.com/bshares): bShares is a bWalletX bApp for companies: keep your register of members, tokenise your shares and lock each holding on chain in multisig. A tool for companies to keep their own records. Nothing is offered or sold on this page.
- [bSpaces](https://bwalletx.com/bspaces): Live audio and video Spaces in token rooms in bWalletX: a stage, raise hand, token-gated entry and full screen. Live in bChat and, since 5.1.85, in bWalletX.
- [bTrust: coming to bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/btrust): bTrust, coming to bWalletX: a Lock with more than one key. Share keys with your solicitor and family, so the people you love are looked after.
- [Bugs: what people told b and what we fixed](https://bwalletx.com/bugs): Bugs people reported to b, the assistant in bWalletX, and where each fix stands: new, planned, fixing or fixed. Entries appear after review.
- [bWeb: your web on bitcoin](https://bwalletx.com/bweb): bWeb (coming) is your own set of bApps inside bWalletX: make each app yours for free, ask b for small changes, or have b build your own version. You pay in small amounts from your wallet.
- [Credits: prepaid credit for services](https://bwalletx.com/credits): Credits are prepaid credit a service issues for its own service. bWalletX holds them and spends them for you. bCredits for b, the bWalletX agent, come first. Credits are in testing.
- [Culture: make it on BSV](https://bwalletx.com/culture): How culture is made with tokens in bWalletX: one token, many kinds of media. Games, pictures, films, music, rooms and live Spaces can all gather around the same token, and tips go straight to the people who make things.
- [bWalletX Desktop](https://bwalletx.com/desktop): bWalletX Desktop: your whole wallet on a big screen at desktop.bwalletx.com. Money, bMail, chat, Spaces, bApps and Ask b side by side. Install it as an app from Chrome, Edge or Safari.
- [Digital Ice-Cream: three friends, one token](https://bwalletx.com/digital-ice-cream): A cartoon story: Fred, Joe and You start an ice-cream stall with a $ICECREAM token split 30/30/40. Every cone sold splits itself, shares stay locked, b helps them agree, and one day they incorporate.
- [bGigs in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/gigs): bGigs in bWalletX: go live on camera in your own Space, sell tickets at the door or charge by the minute, and your fans pay you directly.
- [Ideas: what people asked b for](https://bwalletx.com/ideas): Ideas people sent to b, the assistant in bWalletX, and where each one stands: new, planned, building or shipped. Entries appear after review.
- [Invites: bring people into your Space](https://bwalletx.com/invite): Invite people into a Space with a token attached. They sign in with X or HandCash, get bWalletX, and the token lets them straight into the room's chat.
- [Just b](https://bwalletx.com/just-b): Just b
- [Get your name on Bitcoin](https://bwalletx.com/names): Your own name on Bitcoin, yours forever. One payment, no renewals: $1 for five letters or more, $5 for four, $15 for three. Search it, buy it or claim it, and give one to a friend, in bWalletX.
- [NFTs: everything you own, edge to edge](https://bwalletx.com/nfts): The NFT library in bWalletX Desktop: pictures, clips, music and documents in one grid, opened edge to edge with no frames. Turn a moment from a clip into your card art.
- [Partnership shares: start with friends, incorporate later](https://bwalletx.com/partnership-shares): Start something with friends. Share it fairly with Partnership shares in bWalletX. b drafts the agreement in a chat only the partners are in. Incorporate when you're ready.
- [Send a bMail · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/person): Everything you can do with a person on bWalletX: send a bMail for a penny, call, pay or tip, and chat. Write your message now; bWalletX sends it.
- [Releases](https://bwalletx.com/releases): Every bWalletX release and what it added, newest first. Latest: 5.2.25.
- [Streaming payments: pay as you go](https://bwalletx.com/streaming-payments): Pay as you go in bWalletX: listen to a paid Space, take a paid call or stream music by the second. Set a limit once, stop any time, and the money goes straight to the people you hear.
- [Test bWallet on Android](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwallet/android): Join the bWallet beta on Android through Google Play internal testing (Android 7 or later). What to test, in order: create and restore a wallet, receive and send BSV, get and give a name, chat rooms and DMs, calls, lock and switch accounts. How to send us what you find.
- [Test bWallet on iPhone](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwallet/iphone): Join the bWallet beta on iPhone through TestFlight (iOS 15 or later). What to test, in order: create and restore a wallet, receive and send BSV, get and give a name, chat rooms and DMs, calls, lock and switch accounts. How to send us what you find.
- [Test bWalletX in Chrome](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/chrome-extension): Join the bWalletX Chrome extension test: install, what to test in order (wallet, receive and send, names, Exchange, chat, connecting a site), and how to report.
- [Test bWalletX Desktop](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/desktop): Join the bWalletX Desktop test at desktop.bwalletx.com: install it as an app, what to test in order and how to report.
- [Test bWalletX on the web](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/web): Join the bWalletX web test at web.bwalletx.com: what to test in order (wallet, receive and send, names, Exchange, chat, coming back later) and how to report.
- [Tips: pay the people who make things](https://bwalletx.com/tips): In bWalletX Desktop, tip artists, NFT creators, rooms, people in chat, friends and Spaces speakers. Pick an amount, tap Allow once, and all of it goes to them.
- [Token curves: how a person's token is priced](https://bwalletx.com/token-curves): Every person's token in bWalletX sells on the same gentle curve: 1 cent to join their room, doubling every 10,000 supporters. The money goes to the person. Nothing is held back, there is no reserve and no buy-back, and resale is between people on the Exchange.

## Wallet features

- [bWalletX Exchange](https://bwalletx.com/exchange): Buy and sell anything on-chain, wallet to wallet: tokens, NFTs, people’s $HANDLE tokens and AI trading strategies. Only in bWalletX.
- [bWalletX Exchange: Strategies](https://bwalletx.com/exchange/strategies): Strategies for sale on the bWalletX Exchange: programs your agent account runs, sold as encrypted NFTs. Compare the spec, buy in bWalletX, test it on live prices first.
- [Mint with bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/mint): Mint your art, music, films, books, tickets, coins and contracts on Bitcoin SV with bWalletX. What you can make, what it costs, and what to watch out for.
- [PNEEs: Penny Stablecoins](https://bwalletx.com/pnees): PNEEs (Penny Stablecoins): digital pennies on BSV, one US cent each, backed only by BSV locked in public vaults. No bank, no co-signer on transfers, no freeze. Live mainnet pilot.
- [Pots in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/pots): A pot is money set aside inside your wallet. Standing orders and subscriptions pay from it, and the pot balance is the most they can ever take.
- [Subscriptions in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/subscriptions): Put money aside in a pot and pay regular amounts from it. The pot balance is the most anyone can take. Pause or cancel any time.
- [Lock BSV](https://bwalletx.com/lock): Lock BSV until a date, or as payouts over time: dollar targets, fixed BSV or a percentage. Nobody can unlock it early, not even you. Live since 5.1.85. New feature: start small.
- [Verify a lock](https://bwalletx.com/lock/verify): Check a bWalletX lock or lock receipt against the BSV blockchain: amounts, unlock heights and whether each lock has been claimed.
- [Token locking](https://bwalletx.com/token-locking): Lock tokens the way Lock BSV locks BSV: creator vesting at launch with a public receipt, personal token locks, and airdrops that unlock over time. Coming, pending a mainnet indexer test.
- [Launchpad](https://bwalletx.com/launchpad): Launch your own coin, with something behind it. Buy and sell TokenBlaster coins in bWalletX, launch your own, and add a website, app and socials. Holding a coin opens its bChat room.
- [Identity in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/identity): Some things need a real person behind the wallet: signing a contract, investing in a private placement, a regulated service. Verify once with bit-sign and Veriff. Your wallet holds no name or date of birth, and nothing personal goes on chain.
- [Identity map](https://bwalletx.com/identity-map): Your identity key is who you are. Every other key in bWalletX is derived from it by purpose and by the person you deal with, and names are labels that point at those keys. Restoring 12 words brings it all back.
- [Handles in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/handles): Your $handle is your paymail, and it can be your token and your room. Numbered handles from $bwallet0101, renames, linked accounts, your card signature, and Sign in with bWalletX or X.
- [bAvatars: your name, as art you can scan](https://bwalletx.com/bavatars): Every Bitcoin name gets its own bAvatar: gold art blended from Bloom, Deco, Kintsugi, Orbit and Sigil, drawn from the name. Scan it with any camera. Live on bChatX and in paymail profiles.
- [Swap into BSV: 1,000+ coins, straight to your wallet](https://bwalletx.com/swap): In bWalletX, swap BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL and 1,000+ other coins into BSV, paid straight into your own wallet. Nobody holds your coins. Swaps are run by ChangeNOW.
- [Your signature · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/sign): Flip your bWalletX card and sign the back with your finger. Your signature stays on your device. Next: sign bit-sign contracts with it and seal them on Bitcoin for under a penny.
- [Games in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/games): Play games on Bitcoin SV, all in bGames inside bWalletX: bGames originals, the TokenBlaster arcade and more BSV games.

## Social

- [bWalletX Social](https://bwalletx.com/social): Your handle is your paymail, your token and your chat room. Sign in with X or Google, hold friends’ tokens, chat in token rooms, post to the Feed, call and pay friends.
- [Chat in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/chat): BSV is a messaging protocol, so BSV conversation should live on it. Chat is built into bWalletX: rooms, token rooms, private messages and calls, with bChat as the full version.
- [bMail](https://bwalletx.com/bmail): bMail: email where every letter carries a stamp. Penny post, 1¢ to reach anyone; friends free and on top; Requests for strangers and airdrops. In bWalletX now.
- [bWalletX Friends](https://bwalletx.com/friends): Your handle is your paymail, your token and your chat room. How bWalletX friends, user tokens, the market and token-gated rooms work.
- [bWallet Lounge on bChat](https://bwalletx.com/lounge): The bWallet Lounge is where bWallet and bWalletX people talk: questions, ideas, and the team is there. Type /b to ask the $b assistant any time. Open to everyone.
- [Live in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/live): Your token is your ticket. Holders get into your room in bWalletX and watch you live. What works today in bChat and the wallet, and what is coming.
- [Airdrops](https://bwalletx.com/airdrops): Airdrops: tokens and NFTs sent straight to holders. Your airdrop address, an Airdrops inbox with Keep and Hide, and the safety rules. Live since 5.1.85.
- [Sign in with Gmail · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/gmail): Sign in to bWalletX with your Gmail account and get a verified name: yourname.gmail@bwalletx.com. Your paymail, your token and your chat room, with your Google picture.
- [Sign in with X · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/x): Sign in to bWalletX with your X account and get a verified name: yourhandle.x@bwalletx.com. Your paymail, your token and your chat room, with your X picture.

## Agents & developers

- [The b agent · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/agent): The b agent is the AI assistant inside bWalletX: ask how the wallet works, design strategies, or call it into a chat with /b. Use your own API key, or pay per message.
- [Hold to talk to b](https://bwalletx.com/hold-to-talk): Hold to talk to b: the wallet and CLI are MIT-licensed on GitHub. What that means for your keys, balances, tokens and locks if we ever disappear.
- [bWalletX Agent Accounts](https://bwalletx.com/agents): Give each AI its own bWalletX account, its own budget and its own ghost. Daily caps, Stop all, an activity log, and the CLI or MCP for Claude and other agents.
- [bWalletX Strategies](https://bwalletx.com/strategies): Tell the b agent your idea: it writes the strategy, tests it against live prices and packages it as an encrypted NFT to sell on Exchange › Strategies. Buyers load it into their own agent, with spending limits the wallet enforces.
- [bWalletX Strategy Spec](https://bwalletx.com/strategies/spec): The bWalletX strategy file format (bwalletx.strategy/1), the rules the wallet enforces, paper mode, and how strategies are sold as encrypted NFTs.
- [bWalletX for Developers](https://bwalletx.com/developers): Add a Connect with bWalletX button to your site: one script, a standard BRC-100 wallet, no API keys.
- [Sign in with bWalletX · Developer guide](https://bwalletx.com/connect): Add Sign in with bWalletX to your app: the user's wallet signs a one-time challenge with its identity key and your server checks it with @bsv/sdk. One script tag, server code, security notes, and steps for AI agents.
- [Add Sign in with bWalletX to your site](https://bwalletx.com/sign-in-button): The standard Sign in with bWalletX button: one tag, gold, dark or light, four sizes, React wrapper, SVG files and brand rules. Also works with bWallet.
- [bWalletX CLI](https://bwalletx.com/cli): Run your bWalletX wallet and AI agents from the command line: balances, sends, trades and strategies, on your laptop or a server.
- [bWalletX MCP](https://bwalletx.com/mcp): Let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP agent use your bWalletX agent accounts: balances, sends, trades and strategies, within the budget and limits you set.
- [Add your app to bWallet](https://bwalletx.com/apps/add): Built a BSV app? Add it to the Apps screen in bWallet and bWalletX, in front of every wallet user. Free, reviewed by a person.
- [Open source bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/open-source): bWalletX is open source: the wallet and CLI are MIT-licensed on GitHub. What that means for your keys, balances, tokens and locks if we ever disappear.
- [Sign in with bWalletX (Markdown)](https://bwalletx.com/connect.md): Plain Markdown for AI coding agents.

## Blog

- [001 Forking Yours Wallet onto phones · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/001-the-fork): We took the Yours Wallet browser extension and wrapped it as an iPhone and Android app with Capacitor, without rewriting its code.
- [002 Four names in a week · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/002-four-names): Yours Wallet Mobile, bCorp Wallet, bWallet, then bWalletX. Why the name kept changing, and why there are now two apps.
- [003 Tabs, apps and a social feed · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/003-tabs-apps-feed): The phone layout changed many times. We added an Apps home screen with 100+ BSV apps, a Media player and a feed that reads other BSV social apps.
- [004 Names, handles and paymail · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/004-names-and-paymail): Send to $handle, name@bwalletx.com or an OpNS name. The paymail server moved domain twice, and social sign-in became a verified name.
- [005 Personal tokens and token rooms · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/005-personal-tokens-and-rooms): Hold a token to enter its chat room. Your $NAME is a token with its own room. How rooms, tickets and issuers came together, and what we reversed.
- [006 Who pays for indexing · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/006-paying-for-indexing): A BSV-21 token only shows up in wallets once an indexer lists it. Working out who pays for that, and how much, took four attempts.
- [007 Store rules, open rooms and moderation · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/007-store-and-private): We audited the app against App Store and Play rules, split it into four release channels and built the safety features the stores require.
- [008 Building the Exchange, and why buys broke · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/008-the-exchange): Listing and buying 1Sat tokens from the wallet. Most of the work was not the screens but storage limits, double-encrypted records and slow APIs.
- [009 The b agent: paid, or your own key · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/009-the-b-agent): An assistant inside the wallet. It started free, became paid-only within a day, and now asks for consent before it sends anything.
- [010 Agent accounts, strategies, CLI and MCP · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/010-agents-strategies-cli): Separate wallet accounts for agents, spending rules the wallet enforces, a market for strategies, and a command-line tool that keeps keys on the phone.
- [011 From a dollar bond to PNEEs on mainnet · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/011-pnees-pilot): A BSV-backed dollar token went from a design note to a small, capped mainnet pilot in two days. This is what is enforced, what is not, and what went wrong.
- [012 The extension, the web app and pairing · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/012-extension-and-web): bWalletX also runs as a Chrome and Brave extension and as a web app. On iPhone the web app is the only way to get the full wallet, so we made backup mandatory there.
- [013 Two sites from one · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/013-sites-and-navigation): A download page became bwallet.space, then bwalletx.com became the main site, with the store site generated from it. And this blog.
- [014 One feed for BSV · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/014-open-feed): Every BSV social app keeps its own feed. bChat shows all of them, credits them, and pays the people who wrote the posts.
- [015 Launchpad, and checking what we sign · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/015-launchpad): bWalletX 5.1.74 can buy and sell bonding-curve coins. The wallet now checks every trade the server prepares before it signs anything.
- [016 Subscriptions, paid from pots · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/016-pots): Out in bWalletX 5.1.75: put money aside in a pot, set up regular payments from it, and pause them any time. Free, billing off.
- [017 Sign in with bWalletX, and the Lounge · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/017-sign-in-and-lounge): bChat now has one gold button to sign in with your wallet. Every account starts in the bWallet Lounge.
- [018 1 BSV for testing bWallet on Android · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/018-testers): Google needs 12 people to test bWallet for 14 days before it can go on the Play Store. We are paying 1 BSV for that time.
- [019 Blur slurs, show swearing · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/019-language-filter): The bChat feed and bWalletX now blur slurs behind a tap. Swearing is shown. Nothing is deleted.
- [020 Sign in with X · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/020-sign-in-with-x): bWalletX can make a wallet from your X account. You get your X username as a verified paymail, alice.x@bwalletx.com for example, with your picture, a token and a room.
- [021 Coordinate on BSV · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/021-coordinate-on-bsv): Big platforms put every community in one room. BSV needs a place to plan that it controls. Chat in bWalletX is that place: the first post in a series on chat on BSV.
- [022 Bring your coins home · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/022-bring-your-coins-home): BSV coins sit in wallets that closed, changed hands or changed their paths. The 12 words still work. How bWalletX restores or sweeps them, and what has to stay behind.
- [023 Locks you can’t break · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/023-lock-bsv): Lock BSV until a date, or as payouts over time, and nobody can unlock it early, not even you. Why that is useful, how BSV enforces it with no custodian, and where the limits are.
- [024 Pay the person who wrote it · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/024-tips-and-paid-likes): Tips and paid likes in bWalletX 5.1.72: the payment goes to the author in the same transaction as the like. Why bChat takes 0%, why the home app gets 5% on top, and how authors can hide their own posts.
- [025 Push notifications, from our own server · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/025-push-notifications): Since bWalletX 5.1.70, phones, the web wallet and the extension get push notifications from push.bwalletx.com. What notifies you, what the server knows and doesn’t, and what it costs.
- [026 Paying to be heard · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/026-paying-to-be-heard): Priced token rooms in bWalletX: each message burns tokens or pays the issuer, in one transaction. The wallet signs, the server checks before anything is spent. Admins exempt, 50-sat minimum.
- [027 Airdrops, not dividends · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/027-airdrops-not-dividends): Why bWalletX issuers reward holders with airdrops, not payouts: the returns-wording block, the airdrop inbox, and the security audit behind it (sandboxed NFT content, address poisoning).
- [028 Launch something with your coin · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/028-launch-something): A coin should launch with something: token links for website, app, X, Telegram and bChat; the room as the default right; “Issuer says” for the rest; no company field; advanced launch options as plans.
- [029 bPositive: gifts, not investments · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/029-bpositive): bPositive lets you sponsor someone’s journey in bWalletX: monthly support, witness-confirmed milestone pledges, thank-you NFTs. Why it is gifts only, and the decisions behind it.
- [030 bPhone: charge to receive calls · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/030-bphone): bPhone lets you charge to receive calls in bWalletX: a price per second, minute, hour or call, in BSV, MNEE or a token, paid wallet to wallet while you talk. How the meter works, why there is no middleman, and what is still to do.
- [031 bWalletX 5.1.88: a new Calls tab, working mics, a new menu · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/031-calls-mics-menu): bWalletX 5.1.88 is out on the App Store, Play, the web wallet, the extension and the APK: a Calls tab with a keypad, microphones that work in Spaces and calls, and a new account menu.
- [032 Meet bChatX.com · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/032-meet-bchatx): Chat has a new home at www.bchatx.com: bWalletX colours, a bottom bar, sign in with bWalletX first, a faster feed and new feed safety controls. Your wallet is bWalletX.
- [033 Spaces you can just listen to · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/033-spaces-you-can-listen-to): Spaces on www.bchatx.com/spaces: see who is live, listen to public Spaces without signing in, read pages for ended Spaces, and start your own. A relay now lets strict networks join.
- [034 Open apps, open protocol · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/034-open-apps-open-protocol): Why chat on BSV should be open: MIT-licensed apps, a public bChat Protocol on GitHub, a proposal for threads across apps, and a server that stays closed for now but can’t spend your money.
- [035 Pots & Locks, and backing PNEEs · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/035-pots-and-locks): The Lock screen is now Pots & Locks: locks grouped into pots like Pension or Savings goal, every lock feature kept, and a PNEEs pot for BSV locked to back PNEEs.
- [036 Subscriptions, priced in dollars · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/036-subscriptions-in-dollars): Subscriptions in bWalletX are priced in dollars and paid in BSV at that day’s rate. Each one pays from a pot you choose. Pause or cancel any time. Nothing is paid up front.
- [037 Portfolio vs market · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/037-portfolio-vs-market): Tap the price tile in bWalletX to see how your wallet did against just holding BSV, holding BTC or keeping dollars, over a day, week, month, year or all time.
- [038 Swap into BSV · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/038-swap-into-bsv): Swap BTC, ETH and 1,000+ other coins into BSV from the bWalletX home screen. ChangeNOW runs the swap; the BSV is sent straight to your wallet.
- [039 bGigs: your stage, your fans · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/039-bgigs-your-stage-your-fans): Artists can play live to their fans from anywhere, sell tickets at the door or by the minute, and get paid straight away. It works today in bWalletX.
- [040 Pay artists by the second · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/040-pay-artists-by-the-second): Echoes in the Abyss by VexVoid is in bWalletX. The first six tracks are free, the rest cost 1 sat a second, and the money goes straight to the artist.
- [041 NFTs that just work · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/041-nfts-that-just-work): Sending an NFT is now two steps. NFTs sent to you say who sent them, open in a viewer, and wait for you to keep them. Video NFTs show their cover, and duplicates can be burned.
- [042 Chats that feel like Telegram · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/042-chats-that-feel-like-telegram): Chats in bWalletX open straight away and the list stays still. Swipe a chat to pin, mute, archive or mark it read.
- [043 Ask b · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/043-ask-b): b, the helper inside bWalletX, has a calmer home. Hold the gold b to talk, and your chats on bChatX now have their own links and are encrypted with your wallet.
- [044 Your token's own page and agent · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/044-your-tokens-own-page-and-agent): Every token on bChatX has a full page: price, chart, holders, posts and a Buy button. Its creator can give it an agent, and holders can show a badge name.
- [045 Your card, your art · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/045-your-card-your-art): The card in bWalletX can wear your own pictures or your NFTs, with standard colour sliders. And bPics lets you mint a picture from your phone.
- [046 Stays unlocked, sends exactly · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/046-stays-unlocked-sends-exactly): bWalletX no longer locks itself after a few minutes, and fingerprint unlock on Android works again. Token sends show the exact amount before anything is paid.
- [047 Pay the artist · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/047-pay-the-artist): bMusic is on bWalletX Desktop. Anyone can open an artist page and hear the first track without signing in. The next tracks are paid for by the artist, and after that your money goes straight to them.
- [048 Your NFTs, edge to edge · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/048-your-nfts-edge-to-edge): bWalletX Desktop has an NFT library. Every picture, clip and song you own is in one grid, opens edge to edge, and a moment from a video can become the art on your card.
- [049 The Exchange, sorted · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/049-the-exchange-sorted): The Market in bWalletX Desktop is now the Exchange. Browse by category, platform and tag, swap in place, and find your friends: buy a little of someone’s own token and open their room in one go.
- [050 bTV: AIVJ — VexVoid, live · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/050-aivj-tv-vexvoid-live): bTV: AIVJ is where VexVoid plays live audio-visual sets. Watch the first three minutes without signing in. After that it’s 1p a minute from your bWalletX, straight to the artist.
- [051 Spaces on a schedule, b on every page · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/051-spaces-schedule-and-ask-b): Spaces in bWalletX Desktop have a weekly schedule in your own time zone, with Add to calendar. And Ask b is now a small bar at the bottom of every page.
- [052 Tip buttons · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/052-tip-buttons): bWalletX Desktop has a Tip button for artists, NFT creators, rooms, people in chat, friends and speakers in Spaces. Pick an amount, tap Allow once, and all of it goes to them.
- [053 Friends, bPics and video in rooms · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/053-friends-bpics-and-video): Friends has its own page on bWalletX Desktop, bPics looks like a photo app, and video links play inside the Feed and chat rooms.
- [054 bRadio: live audio in bWalletX · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/054-bradio-live-audio): Host a live audio Space, bring people up to speak, and keep listening while you use the rest of the wallet. Recorded Spaces can become podcast episodes.
- [055 Digital Ice-Cream · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/055-digital-ice-cream): A story about three friends, an ice-cream stand and digital cash, and where we’re taking bWalletX next.
- [056 bShares: a register for companies · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/056-bshares): bShares keeps a company’s register of members, lets directors approve new shares, and locks shares so they can’t move without the right people. It’s in private testing.
- [057 Sign in with HandCash, and invites with tokens · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/057-handcash-and-invites): New accounts can now start with HandCash as well as X. Your HandCash handle carries over as name@bwalletx.com, your friends can come with you, and invites with tokens bring people into Spaces.
- [bWalletX development blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/): How bWallet and bWalletX were built from a fork of Yours Wallet: numbered posts from the git history, including what broke, what we reversed and what is still not done.
